study.plan: City of Phoenix 2026 Heat Response Plan DRAFT (2.13.2026)
study.timezone_note: Arizona is UTC-7 year-round; the state does not observe DST.

summary.baseline: citywide proxy (area-weighted AOI mean) - a stand-in for station-based sensing, not a station feed

population_source: US Census ACS 5-year 2023 block groups, areally interpolated onto village boundaries

clauses.action: Activate summer heat protocols including cold immersion techniques
clauses.source_text: Protective directives are implemented when temperatures exceed 105°F, deploying additional resources and implementing enhanced rehabilitation measures.

clauses.action: Close Select Trailheads on Extreme Heat Warning Days
clauses.source_text: The program restricts access to select trails when the National Weather Service issues an Extreme Heat Warning.

clauses.action: Season-severity benchmark: daily high at or above 110 degF
clauses.source_text: Temperatures at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport hit at least 110°F on 37 days and there were 31 days with National Weather Service Extreme Heat Warnings in effect.
actor: Office of Heat Response and Mitigation

clauses.action: Season-severity benchmark: overnight low at or above 90 degF
clauses.source_text: Nighttime temperatures failed to drop below 90°F at Sky Harbor on 23 days, including a seasonal high overnight low of 95°F on July 10.
actor: Office of Heat Response and Mitigation
